paragraphs.text: Fear Island is an island somewhere in the Sea of Serenity in southwestern Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

Around 3290 AR , Declan , later city architect of Palmyra , was a young man who planned the fortifications of Fear Island. The island was attacked by King Gaynor , but Declan's excellent defense split the king's navy on the rocks of the island.
